about_the_game:
A sound that sparks excitement, making your heart leap with joy♪ FINAL FANTASY × kawaii arrangements are now available as a music album!

The kawaii sounds of #SQkawaii brought to you by SQUARE ENIX MUSIC, feature 20 carefully selected tracks from the iconic FINAL FANTASY series, arranged in a kawaii future bass style with sparkling synths and upbeat rhythms.

FINAL FANTASY heroines and mascot characters, playfully hanging out at a game center, have been newly illustrated by SQUARE ENIX character designer Yasuhiro Izumisawa.

Enjoy the iconic melodies of FINAL FANTASY enhanced by kawaii sounds, bringing heart-lifting moments to you!
